title: Two Marks Inside a Verb
label: ch:bn-two-marks-inside-a-verb
canDo: I can write the independent ও, explain why a vowel following a vowel cannot be a sign, add the dot that turns য into a glide, and read হওয়া — the verb of being — straight off the page.

payoff.summary: The verb of being is read whole from four pieces bought in this chapter and the last, and set beside হ্যাঁ to show that stacked pieces make one syllable and pieces in a row make several.
